description: This file defines a PlaceholderState struct and associated methods to manage placeholders in internationalization (i18n) contexts, involving pattern matching and unique placeholder generation.

classes.name: PlaceholderState
classes.description: A struct that manages placeholder generation and tracking for i18n text processing.
